scene: Upstairs, you find a mist-shrouded rooftop bathhouse promenade.
picture: Side-scrolling view of a stone rooftop terrace. On the far left hangs a brass bell beside the top of the stairs. The player in lilac headscarf and mustard coat stands left of centre. At the centre, a huge capybara soaks in a shallow steaming bath. A rope bridge extends on the far right.
shown: a hanging brass bell on a post at the far left
a giant calm capybara soaking in a tiled bath at the centre
a swaying wooden rope bridge anchored on the far right
